name: inkpaperui-monorepo
description: Line-art UI for Tailwind CSS v4: ink outlines on warm paper, one red accent, lines that look drawn by hand.
author: Carson Hung (https://github.com/carsonhung)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=inkpaperui-icons && npm run build --workspace=inkpaperui-demo
scripts.test: npm run check --workspace=inkpaperui-icons && npm run check --workspace=inkpaperui-css
